title: Guardian Employee Enrollment and Change Packet - RTEC reference, 2026
summary: Six-page blank Guardian employee enrollment/change packet. The pages cover employee enrollment and coverage changes, dependent details, basic life and accidental death coverage, voluntary life selections, short-term disability selections, employee acknowledgments, and state-specific fraud statements. The source PDF was visually checked on all six pages and contains no completed employee/dependent entries. Its effective date and current use are unknown.
